components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The standard action on light surfaces: outlined, quiet, optional leading icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="M3 8a5 5 0 1 0 1.6-3.7"/><path d="M3 2v3h3"/></svg>Reset</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:8px; font-family: var(--font); font-weight:600; font-size:0.95rem; color: var(--aubergine); background: var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line-strong); cursor:pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--tint); border-color: var(--aubergine-3); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: On-dark Button
components.description: Actions inside the aubergine chrome (Refresh, Projection settings).

components.description: Tabs in the sticky aubergine header; the active tab carries a cyan underline.
components.html: FPL Price PredictionPrice WatchWhat ifHow it works
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:stretch; gap:4px; min-height:64px; padding:0 24px; background: var(--aubergine); } .ds-brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-right:36px; color: var(--on-dark); font-family: var(--font-fig); font-size:1.35rem; font-weight:500; } .ds-brand b { font-weight:800; } .ds-mark { width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:8px; background: var(--cyan); } .ds-tab { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:0 14px; color: var(--on-dark-soft); font-family: var(--font); font-weight:600; font-size:.98rem; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:3px solid transparent; transition: color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--on-dark); } .ds-tab.ds-active { color: var(--on-dark); border-bottom-color: var(--cyan); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: Delta Chips
components.description: The predicted move, classified on the one £0.1m threshold: rise, fall, or holds.
components.html: +£0.6m −£0.4m Holds

components.html: GK DEF MID FWD

components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:4px; background: var(--tint); border-radius:999px; } .ds-seg-opt { padding:7px 18px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; font-family: var(--font); font-weight:700; font-size:.95rem; color: var(--ink-soft); cursor:pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { color: var(--aubergine); } .ds-seg-opt.ds-on { background: var(--aubergine); color: var(--on-dark); } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow: var(--focus); }

components.name: Shirt Spot
components.description: Signature: club shirt, white name plate, aubergine price strip reading today's price then next season's.
components.css: .ds-pitch { padding:20px; border-radius:14px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, var(--pitch-a) 0, var(--pitch-a) 64px, var(--pitch-b) 64px, var(--pitch-b) 128px); } .ds-spot { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; width:128px; padding:4px 0 0; background:none; border:0; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; transition: transform .2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-spot:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-spot:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--cyan); } .ds-shirt { width:60px; height:60px; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25)); transition: filter .2s ease; } .ds-spot:hover .ds-shirt { filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35)); } .ds-plate { display:block; width:100%; margin-top:4px; padding:3px 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-fig); font-weight:700; font-size:.98rem; border-radius:5px 5px 0 0; } .ds-strip { display:block; width:100%; padding:3px 6px; background: var(--aubergine); color: var(--on-dark-soft); font-family: var(--font-fig); font-weight:600; font-size:.95rem; border-radius:0 0 5px 5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-strip b { font-weight:800; color: var(--rise-fill); }

components.description: Signature: the predicted price as a tag with a punched hole, above the 95% likely-range bar.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-answer { padding:20px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-tag { position:relative; display:inline-block; padding:14px 26px 14px 44px; background: var(--aubergine); color: var(--on-dark); border-radius:6px 14px 14px 6px; } .ds-tag::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:16px; top:50%; width:12px; height:12px; margin-top:-6px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--surface); } .ds-tag-label { font-family: var(--font); font-size:.9rem; font-weight:600; color: var(--on-dark-soft); } .ds-tag-price { font-family: var(--font-fig); font-size:3.6rem; font-weight:800; line-height:.95; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-range { position:relative; height:14px; margin-top:30px; background: var(--tint); border-radius:999px; } .ds-band { position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; left:15%; width:65%; background:#cdb3d8; border-radius:999px; } .ds-point { position:absolute; top:50%; left:42%; width:22px; height:22px; margin:-11px 0 0 -11px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--aubergine); border:4px solid var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(43,0,51,.35); }

components.name: Stat Chip Editor
components.description: An editable season figure: label, large condensed number, a stepper each side, a hint.
components.html: Seen 0 to 36.
components.css: .ds-stat { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; width:196px; padding:10px 12px; background: var(--paper); border-radius:10px; } .ds-stat:focus-within { background: var(--tint); } .ds-stat-label { font-family: var(--font); font-weight:600; font-size:.9rem; color: var(--ink); } .ds-stat-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; } .ds-stat-input { flex:1; min-width:0; height:40px; padding:0 4px; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid var(--line-strong); background:transparent; text-align:center; font-family: var(--font-fig); font-size:1.55rem; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--aubergine); } .ds-stat-input:focus { outline:none; border-bottom-color: var(--aubergine-3); } .ds-step { display:grid; place-items:center; width:32px; height:32px; flex:none; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:50%; background: var(--surface); color: var(--aubergine); cursor:pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease, border-color .12s ease, transform .12s ease; } .ds-step:hover { background: var(--aubergine); border-color: var(--aubergine); color: var(--on-dark); } .ds-step:active { transform: scale(.92); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow: var(--focus); } .ds-stat-hint { font-family: var(--font); font-size:.8rem; line-height:1.35; color: var(--ink-soft); }

components.name: Transfer List Row

components.css: .ds-list { background: var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow:hidden; } .ds-lh, .ds-lr { display:grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 84px 84px; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:0 20px; } .ds-lh { height:40px; background: var(--aubergine); color: var(--on-dark-soft); font-family: var(--font); font-weight:600; font-size:.88rem; } .ds-lr { width:100%; min-height:60px; border:0; background: var(--surface); text-align:left; color: var(--ink); cursor:pointer; transition: background-color .12s ease; } .ds-lr:hover { background: var(--tint); } .ds-lr:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow: inset var(--focus); } .ds-who { display:flex; flex-direction:column; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-who small { color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-now, .ds-pred { font-family: var(--font-fig); font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:600; text-align:right; } .ds-pred { font-weight:800; color: var(--aubergine); }

narrative.overview:
The app lives inside the game its users already open every night. It borrows Fantasy Premier League's own grammar instead of a dashboard's: deep aubergine chrome, a striped pitch with an XI of club shirts, a name plate and price tag under every shirt, position pills, a transfer list, and a player card that slides in from the right. A stranger to the model should recognise the furniture before reading a word, and trust the answer because it is presented the way prices are always presented to them.

The page is a light, dense working surface (paper ground, white list and panel surfaces) framed top and bottom by aubergine chrome. Figures carry the weight: Barlow Condensed, heavy, uppercase for headings and tabular for every price. Colour is spent sparingly and with meaning. Cyan marks the chrome (brand, active tab, selection, the predicted point on the range bar); green and pink-red mark a price moving and nothing else; four saturated position colours sort players. Motion is short and ease-out: shirts lift on hover, the player card slides in and its sections rise in sequence, and all of it is removed under reduced-motion.

The build rejects the admin-dashboard stack of a form, then a card, then a chart. Even the What-if editor is a player sheet: the answer pinned as a price tag on the left, the season's figures as editable stat chips on the right.
keyCharacteristics: Aubergine chrome frames a light paper working surface; no dark mode.
Figures in heavy Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals; UI text in Barlow.
Club-coloured SVG shirts drawn from kit facts, never crests or photos.
Direction colour is reserved: green rises, pink-red falls, a neutral tint holds.
Every predicted price is shown as a tag: today's price, then next season's.
Desktop-first; phone layout and screen-reader semantics are not yet designed.

rules.name: The Direction-Only Rule
rules.body: In the interface, green and pink-red mean a price is moving and nothing else: not success, not error, not a brand accent. The pitch turf and club kits are the world's own materials and are exempt; position colours and chart series avoid both hues.

rules.name: The One Threshold Rule
rules.body: A price has moved when the predicted change is at least £0.1m either way; anything smaller holds. Every chip, tag, verdict and colour uses that one threshold.

rules.name: The Cyan-Is-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Cyan decorates the frame and marks the current selection. It never encodes a value.

rules.name: The Tabular Price Rule
rules.body: Every price and stat is set in Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals, written £7.5m, and signed with a true minus (−£0.4m) or ± when it rounds to zero.

rules.name: The Condensed Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings are Barlow Condensed and uppercase; sentences are Barlow in sentence case. Do not set running text in the condensed face.

rules.name: The Lift Means Reach Rule
rules.body: Shadows deepen only for things the user is about to open. Resting surfaces all share the one ambient shadow.

dos: **Do** show every predicted price as a pair, today's then next season's, with the predicted figure heavier.
**Do** classify every move with the one £0.1m threshold before choosing a colour or a word.
**Do** give every position both its colour and its marker shape in charts.
**Do** draw club shirts from kit colours, with a neutral kit for clubs outside the table.
**Do** set prices and stats in Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals, using a true minus sign.
**Do** keep chart styling on the light surface: aubergine hover labels, soft-rule gridlines, Barlow type.
**Do** honour reduced-motion by removing all animation and transition.
donts: **Don't** use green or pink-red in the interface for anything but price direction; the pitch and club kits are the only exceptions.
**Don't** fall back to the stacked form, then card, then chart arrangement; present players on the pitch, in the list, or on a sheet.
**Don't** use club crests or photographed shirts.
**Don't** add a dark mode by inverting the light palette; one would need its own steps.
**Don't** treat phone layout or screen-reader behaviour as designed; both are open work.
